messages:
Mona: Quick sync — devex roadmap priorities for Q3 (SDKs / docs / quickstarts / samples). Proposing 3 pillars: 1) TypeScript SDK GA + typings, 2) three canonical quickstarts (node, python, private deploy), 3) sample-app gallery with 2 launch apps. Need scope, launch criteria, and owners by EOD Fri. Thoughts?

Raj: +1 on TS SDK GA. Blockers: streaming API surface, function-calling typings, and CI to publish nightly. If we freeze API surface now, ETA ~6w.

Jules: For the gallery I recommend 2 small apps for launch: embeddings-based notes app and chat-with-tools demo. Keep them single-purpose, reusable components, and include deploy previews. I can lead but need ~0.5 eng allocation.

Liam: Docs priorities: concise quickstarts (15–20 min), a migration guide from 0.x -> 1.x, and a security section for Private (KMS/HSM + network config examples). Quickstarts must have a CPU-local example for folks without GPUs.

Kai: Heads-up — AcmeCorp asked for an on‑prem SDK example and explicit KMS/HSM guidance. They said this is blocking their POC. If we surface that as a must-have, CS will escalate.

Mona: Ok — let's triage customer asks. Proposal: patch the security guide (KMS/HSM) as a docs spike (1wk). TS types + basic examples as SDK priority (shipable), streaming & function-call typings as follow-up. Samples: ship 2 minimal apps for launch.

Raj: Implementation plan for TS: split into A) types-only release (1 week) and B) streaming + function typings (3 additional weeks). I recommend we do A for GA. Also need a small spec for the typings — can we lock that today?

Jules: Sample-app launch checklist idea: canonical repo layout, README with tutorial, CI that runs tests & builds a preview, 1 short tutorial video (2–3 min), and seed data. Launch criteria: passes CI, README + tutorial, and a maintainer assigned.

Mona: Draft launch criteria (short): SDK GA -> published npm + types + 3 example snippets; Docs -> quickstart + migration + security guide; Samples -> 2 apps with CI + tutorial + license. Success metrics: SDK installs 500/mo, quickstart completion rate 40%, sample repo forks 50 in first month. Sound reasonable?

Liam: Also add a telemetry event for quickstart completion (opt-out by default). Will need privacy review and a short PR for docs to include the telemetry opt-out instructions.

Raj: One blocker: we don't have nightly build infra for code examples (so CD to demo sites). Ping eng-infra for a tiny GH Action to publish previews.

Mona: Owners proposal: Raj = SDK, Liam = Docs, Jules = Samples, Mona = PM / coordinator. Timeline: commit scope this week, alpha ship in 4 wks, GA in 6 wks.

Kai: I'll loop in CS + Enterprise AM for the AcmeCorp ask and confirm whether KMS/HSM is a gating item.

docs-bot: Published draft: /docs/devex/ts-sdk-ga-draft (preview) — feedback welcome.

Mona: Great. Action items: Raj draft typings spec (by Tue), Liam draft security guide + quickstart template (by Wed), Jules scaffold two apps + CI (by Thu). Sync Friday 10:00am to finalize scope. :calendar: :rocket:
